name: Rikuzentakata (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Rikuzentakata city emblem in yellow: a ring beneath a stylised crown-like device with a star.
history: Municipal flag of Rikuzentakata, a city in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 June 1955.

features.role: Rikuzentakata city emblem — a ring beneath a stylised crown-like device with a star
